summary.mechanism: P1 (+3 mm) and P3 (flow x 0.8) both raise z_c = U^2 / (B d) by ~12 % (U^2 +12 % / d -11 %); with p_dep = 7 the wiggle bases' chi (#1/#2, design 0.52/0.335) falls to 0.30/0.18 (P1) or 0.39/0.22 (P3), the bases deposit far less foam (white 0.07-0.13 vs 0.18-0.24) and the outer outline they draw opens over the top (layered heart: tip gone; tulip: outer petal splits into two side crescents; leaf/swan: halo/body faint, but their criteria - veins, neck/head/wings - come from saturated chi ~ 1 / ~ 0 strokes and survive). The heart and push heart use only saturated strokes (chi 0.86-1.00 low, <= 0.12 cut) and do not change. Lower (P2) / more flow (P4) push chi up (0.75/0.55, 0.62/0.44): bigger, whiter patterns, all forming. +-50 ms timing changes nothing visible (largest: push heart middle-row seams 7 -> 5, heart cut chi 0.06 -> 0.08).
caveats: swan P4: 100 mL fill, 94 mL poured -> the pitcher would reach 6 mL; the surrogate is clamped at 20 mL from stroke #4 on (run outside the pitcher model's range)
swan P3: the fuller pitcher raises the clearance, the neck #8 / head #9 are lifted 1.9 / 0.8 mm (bottleneck 0.51, the weakest neck)
P2 clipping: swan #8/#9/#11 lose 2.9/2.5/2.1 mm of the 3 mm (spout already at z_min), #4 0.1 (max 1.7); heart #1 max 1.0, tulip #6 0.1 (max 0.5); everything else gets the full -3 mm
layered heart P1/P3: in raw c (unstretched) the outline is faintly closed at c 0.29/0.33; reading that as 'partial' instead of 'no' does not change the result (2 partials also fail)
summary.tolerance: from the random draws: the layered heart outline survives dz #1/#2 = +2.1/+2.4 mm with flow x1.09/1.04 (R1, chi 0.42/0.23, connection c 0.41) and the tulip outline does not survive +2.2/+2.8 mm with x0.99/1.10 (R1, chi 0.35/0.23) -> the usable window for the wiggle-base height is roughly -3 mm (clip) .. +2 mm, i.e. the design sits near the upper (low-deposition) edge of it
